absent: Exact numeric byte offsets and sizes for task register tracing virtualization and override structures.
Predicate table contents for condition checks plus helpers for thread flags signals scheduling and user access checks.
Hardware register bit definitions for barrier enable endian control and capability detection beyond toggle direction.
Signal delivery mapping lookup broadcast interrupt and locking implementations owned elsewhere.
Build configuration defaults early boot programming and logging tracing event internals.
Thumb versus Arm detection helpers and compat mode query implementations.

findings.text: Faulting instruction skip advances the saved program counter by a caller supplied width and then reconciles execution state. For user mode it fast forwards single step state. For compat mode it advances interruptible Thumb state. For native mode it clears branch type controls.

Segmentation fault notification classifies a faulting address by testing for a containing mapping under read protection. Absence of a mapping yields a mapping error code while presence yields an access error code. The lock is released before injecting a segmentation fault signal with the address and zero extra value.

Deprecated instruction dispatcher iterates over a static table of emulation descriptors. It skips entries marked unavailable and entries whose current mode indicates disabled. It invokes each remaining probe with the register snapshot and instruction word and reports success on the first acceptance.
User single step fast forward checks a thread flag for stepping and when set clears the single step control preserved in the saved status of the thread register snapshot.

Instruction field extraction helpers isolate a four bit register selector at a caller supplied offset and isolate coprocessor move fields for secondary opcode and destination mask from an instruction word.

Emulation descriptor is a record holding a name pointer plus a lifecycle status plus a probe callback plus an optional hardware toggle callback plus current mode bounds. The probe accepts a register snapshot and instruction word and reports acceptance as boolean. The toggle accepts an enable flag and reports status as integer. Current mode minimum and maximum are integers with an embedded control table for runtime tuning.

Assembly offset interface emits symbolic constants for task thread information plus stack location plus central processing unit context plus saved general registers plus program counter plus processor status plus system call number plus fault handling state plus tracing frame plus boot data plus feature override plus virtualization host and guest state where configured.

Condition evaluation uses the top four bits of the instruction word. The value fifteen denotes unconditional. Other values index a table of predicates evaluated against saved processor status to yield pass or fail.
Emulation modes are ordered disabled then emulate then hardware. Lifecycle states are ordered deprecated then obsolete then unavailable.

Swap byte selection is determined by a single type bit. Word form to an address that is not a multiple of four is rejected as a memory fault before any user access. Byte form has no alignment rejection.

Swap exchange repeats a privileged user access sequence until the result differs from a transient contention code or a signal becomes pending. Between attempts the processor is yielded. Success returns zero and other stable errors propagate.

Swap handler filters on condition outcome. Pass continues to decode. Fail completes as handled while still tracing and warning and advancing past a four byte instruction. Unconditional encoding is rejected as a memory fault. Any other outcome is rejected as invalid argument.

Swap handler decodes base source and destination register selectors from the instruction word. It reads base address and source value from the user register file. It checks permission for four bytes at the word aligned base. Disallowed range or exchange memory fault diverts to segmentation notification. On success the exchanged value is written to the destination slot.

Barrier handler filters on condition outcome in the same way as swap. It then decodes a coprocessor register field. One value selects the data barrier pair with secondary opcode choosing between two strengths and distinct trace labels. Another value selects the instruction barrier which relies on exception boundaries and only traces.

Endian handler updates a saved status endian bit according to a boolean selector. Big endian sets the bit and little endian clears it. Each direction emits a distinct trace label and a rate limited notice.

Thirty two bit endian form extracts its selector from one bit position and advances four bytes. Sixteen bit Thumb form extracts from another position and advances two bytes. Both share the common endian update routine.
Emulation table is a static list whose membership depends on build configuration. Swap barrier and endian entries each appear only when their respective emulation option is enabled.

Compat Thumb interrupt state advance has no effect unless both Thumb mode and interrupt state mask are set. Terminal block with zero low three bits clears the whole state. Otherwise the top three bits are preserved while the low five shift left by one.

Logical interrupt state of eight bits is split across two nonadjacent saved status fields. Extraction combines a low pair with an upper six bit group. Installation masks both fields out before merging the recombined value.
Single step preserved status clear forwards the user register portion of a snapshot to a dedicated user register helper.
Emulation mode changes are serialized by a dedicated mutex. The control handler holds it across bounded vector update and hardware transition including failure revert. All exit paths release it.
Fault address classification holds the address space read lock while searching for a containing mapping. The lock is released before signal injection so no lock is held during delivery.
Central processing unit bringup programming disables interrupts around iteration over the emulation table. This orders local programming against concurrent broadcast updates from other processors.

Registration assigns bounds from lifecycle status. Minimum is always disabled. Deprecated starts in emulate with hardware allowed and forces hardware off. Obsolete starts disabled with emulate maximum. Unavailable is fixed disabled with disabled maximum.

Mode transition first undoes prior hardware enablement then applies new hardware enablement. Leaving hardware broadcasts disable with a notice. Entering hardware broadcasts enable with a notice and propagates failure. Other modes need no hardware action.

Control write remembers prior mode and applies a bounded integer update. Reads failures or unchanged values stop without transition. Changed values attempt transition and on failure restore the prior value and reapply its hardware state.

Hardware enablement broadcast runs synchronously on every processor. Per processor callbacks invoke the descriptor toggle only when present. Descriptors without a toggle report invalid argument and no broadcast occurs.

Online processor reconciliation reads each current mode once and skips unavailable entries. It programs hardware to enabled exactly when stored mode equals hardware. Per processor programming failure warns with processor identity and descriptor name and yields invalid argument.

Early initialization marks endian unavailable when the system lacks mixed endian at low exception level and marks swap unavailable when an unprivileged access capability is present. Unavailable entries are skipped for registration. A hotplug step is then installed for later processors.
Swap probe requires compat mode without Thumb and a fixed mask comparison on the instruction word. On match it delegates to the swap handler and success is defined as zero return.
Barrier probe uses the same mode gate and accepts either of two fixed mask comparisons for distinct barrier encodings before delegating to the barrier handler.
Endian probe checks Thumb form first with one mask then compat form with another mask. Each match delegates to its width specific handler with success defined as zero return.

Barrier hardware toggle sets the coprocessor enable bit when requested and clears it otherwise. Endian toggle requires mixed endian support and clears a disable bit when requested while setting it otherwise. Swap has no hardware toggle.

Available descriptors expose current mode as a bounded integer control under a fixed directory using the descriptor name. Permissions allow owner read write and others read. Bounds pointers and a custom handler enforce allowed transitions.

Privileged user access is enabled only around the inline atomic exchange sequence. Translation faults on load or store are captured by exception table entries to a common exit. Permission and alignment failures avoid the privileged window and divert to fault notification.

Each emulated instruction counts a software emulation fault and emits an instruction specific trace. A rate limited warning identifies the process and faulting program counter. Handlers then skip the faulting instruction and report handled status to resume execution.
Condition test outcomes are small integers with fail zero pass one and unconditional two.
Unconditional condition selector is decimal fifteen in the top four bits.
Swap byte selector is the single bit at position twenty two.
Privileged exchange retry budget is four attempts before reporting contention.

Instruction recognition uses fixed masks with expected values. Swap mask 0x0fb00ff0 value 0x01000090. Barrier first mask 0x0fff0fdf value 0x0e070f9a second mask 0x0fff0fff value 0x0e070f95. Endian Thumb mask 0xfffffff7 value 0x0000b650 Arm mask 0xfffffdff value 0xf1010000.
Instruction advance widths are four bytes for Arm swap barrier and endian forms and two bytes for Thumb endian form.
Runtime control names use fixed short strings with swap using swp and barrier using cp15 barrier with underscore and endian using setend.
Control file mode is zero six four four octal giving owner read write and others read.
